newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bills yields fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bills yields fall slightly.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills slipped to 47.56 percent from 48.46 percent at the last sale on January 9, a central bank statement said on Saturday.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 8.85 million UAH 8.68 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.91 million UAH 7.75 million UAH
The central bank sold 88,506 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 6,474 were competitive and 82,032 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 14.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.06 percent from 59.23 percent at the last sale on January 9, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 81.72 million UAH 26.76 million UAH
Actual amount raised 63.13 million UAH 20.66 million UAH
The central bank sold 817,205 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 792,250 were competitive and 24,955 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 14.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 61.11 percent from 61.25 percent at the last sale on January 9, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 5.63 million UAH 23.01 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.86 million UAH 15.78 million UAH
The central bank sold 56,355 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 40,000 were competitive and 16,355 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 14.
